interviews.title: Ngaahi ʻinitaviu kuo fakataimitēpileʻí
interviews.description: Ko e taimi-tepile fakangaue pe. ʻOua naʻá ke lekooti ha ngaahi meʻa fakapulipuli ʻi he ʻinitaviú.
interviews.exportCalendar: Tohimāhina ʻo e ʻave ki tuʻapuleʻangá
interviews.offlineNotice: Offline — fakahaaʻi ʻa e taimi-tēpile ʻinitaviu kuo fakahaofi. Lau-pe; ʻoku fie maʻu ʻe he ngaahi liliú ha fehokotaki.
interviews.calendarSubscriptionDescription: Fa’u ha URL tohimāhina fakatāutaha, ‘e lava ke fakafoki ki he ngaahi ‘initaviu kuo fakataimitēpile’i ‘a e uooti ko ‘ení. Ko ha taha pe 'oku 'i ai 'ene URL 'e lava ke ne lau 'a e taimi-tepile ngaue.
interviews.rotateSubscriptionUrl: Fetongi ʻa e URL ʻo e totongi
interviews.subscriptionCreated: Kopi 'a e URL ko 'eni he taimi ni. He ʻikai ke toe fakaʻaliʻali ia.
interviews.subscriptionRevoked: Kuo fakafoki ʻa e totongi ʻo e tohimāhiná.
interviews.interviewDateTime: ʻAho mo e taimi ʻo e ʻinitaviú
interviews.noInterviews: ʻOku ʻikai fakataimitēpileʻi ha ngaahi ʻinitaviu.
